sentences.en: You should look up all unfamiliar words in a dictionary.
sentences.zh: 你应该查字典弄清楚所有不熟悉的单词。

sentences.en: Do you have an extra English dictionary by any chance?
sentences.zh: 你碰巧有备用的英语词典吗？

sentences.en: Whatever language you study, you cannot do without a dictionary.
sentences.zh: 无论学习哪种语言，都离不开一本字典。

senses.zh: 词典, 字典, 辞书, 专业术语大全
